steps.title: Have a GPU and Docker
steps.note: NVIDIA with CUDA 12.8 or newer. Driver 570+ for an RTX 50xx. The image is built on the CUDA devel base because llama-cpp-python is compiled at build time, not downloaded.

steps.title: Set the two things that matter
steps.note: ATELIER_JETON must hold a random secret: empty means the model is refused any code execution. Never set GGML_CUDA_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY.

steps.title: Bring the stack up
steps.note: API, nginx, SearXNG and the execution workshop. Only the web port is published; the rest talk on the internal network.

steps.title: Open it
steps.note: Search a model, download it, load it. For UI work without compiling CUDA, ./start.sh runs uvicorn and Vite natively instead.
